text: Zhik is a Sydney-based sailing-apparel company; its 2023 crowdfunding raise was backed by Zhik's existing investors, including long-time backer Nightingale Partners, according to Inside Small Business.
short: Zhik is a private Sydney company backed by private investors.

source.name: Inside Small Business - Sailing apparel Zhik launches first crowdfunding campaign
source.quote: the Sydney-based company has partnered with crowdfunding platform Equitise and is backed by Zhik’s existing investors
